page.marginRule: Equal on all four edges. Default 0.75in (formal letter). Band 0.65–0.8in. Never shrink a single edge to win space.

contentBox.rule: At 0.75in margins the printable area is 11 − 1.5 = 9.5in tall. Print `.page` uses min-height: 9.5in (NOT fixed height).

pageModel.signoff: .signoff { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 30px; flex: 0 0 auto; text-align: left; break-inside: avoid; }
pageModel.printPage: .page { width: auto; height: auto; min-height: 9.5in; margin: 0; padding: 0; /* NO overflow:hidden */ }
pageModel.rule: ⭐ CZI reference (storage/jenni/_exports/CZI/jenni-czi-letter.html): flex column + growing .letter-main + sign-off pinned with margin-top:auto so whitespace sits ABOVE the closing. Sign-off is bottom-LEFT (Warm regards → script → title → email). Résumés pin bottom-RIGHT — do not conflate.
pageModel.reference: CZI letter — position + padding (padding-top: 30px). Copy geometry, not palette.
⛔forbidden: height: <n>in on .page in print — @page{margin} already insets the printable area; a near-full fixed height overflows the sheet
overflow: hidden on .page in print — combined with a fixed height it CLIPS the sign-off (Sony 2026-07-25)
Leaving the sign-off floating mid-page with no margin-top:auto — short letters look unfinished
pageModel.why: Observed 2026-07-25 (Sony letter): résumé fixed-height + overflow:hidden copied onto a letter sliced the sign-off while every guard passed. Safe pin = flex + min-height (CZI). Unsafe pin = fixed height + overflow:hidden (Netflix/Sony).

signature.pin: margin-top: auto on .signoff (sibling of .letter-main inside flex .page)
signature.not: Résumé bottom-RIGHT (.page-sig / align-self:flex-end) — that is two-page-standard.json

fitToOnePage.rule: A cover letter is EXACTLY 1 page and must never clip. When it does not fit, fix it in THIS order:
order: 1. CUT PROSE — remove the paragraph that duplicates the résumé or restates an earlier point. Best fix; the letter gets stronger.
2. TIGHTEN the closing — merge the final two paragraphs into one.
3. REDUCE body font-size in 0.25px steps within the allowed band (11.5px -> 11.0px -> 10.75px). Below 10.5px is unreadable in print.
4. REDUCE line-height within the band (1.55 -> 1.5 -> 1.45). Below 1.4 the paragraph reads cramped.
5. LAST RESORT: widen @page margin to 0.8in (equal on all edges).
⛔never: Never add a fixed height + overflow:hidden to 'make it fit' — that HIDES the overflow instead of fixing it.
Never let the sign-off land alone on a second page (orphan signature).
Never shrink one margin edge; margins stay equal.

guards: check_pagefit  ⭐ REQUIRED — asserts exactly 1 page, no ink clipped at the content edge, and no orphan sign-off
verifyByEye: Rasterise and LOOK at the bottom 15% of the page (`pdf_to_png`). Confirm sign-off sits at the bottom-LEFT with air above it — not mid-page, not clipped.
bestFor: Every cover letter (exactly 1 page). Résumés → two-page-standard.json; work-samples → work-examples.json.
